contract.instructions: Add graded stage metric primitives to the existing evaluator authority evals/search-quality/search-quality-evaluation.ts per §6.1: four stage observations per task (knownRelevantInRawArms, knownRelevantAfterCoreFusion, knownRelevantInMcpUnion, knownRelevantAfterEligibility), two quality tracks (end-to-end miss accounting; conditional ranking graded metrics only where a grade >= 2 result survives eligibility), judged-pool nDCG@10 with coverage, conditional graded pair accuracy. §7.6 A10 RED row: test 'legacy_owner_metrics_remain_byte_compatible'; expected failure: adding graded metrics changes legacy bytes; minimal passing: legacy outputs are byte-identical. Preserve FIXED_NOW (:20), REQUIRED_LIMITS [1,3,5,10,20] (:22), and hash-bound fixture verification (:248-269). Ownership chain (sequential, non-overlapping): R0.1A (FT-G0) -> A10 -> C6 (FT-C) per §7.1 central-file ownership — coordinate with FT-G0 before and FT-C after. Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5 A10 row) and targets a test file absent at round_base: unverifiable-at-base. Affected command node --import tsx --test evals/search-quality/search-quality-evaluation.test.ts is repo-verified as an existing test file (same invocation pattern as the plan's R0.1A/C6 rows for evals/search-quality tests); it is RED at base per the task packet, so a pre-change failure is expected and not evidence of regression.
